question: An adversary swaps legitimate system hardware with counterfeit or tampered components during supply-chain distribution, enabling disruption or later compromise after deployment. Which MITRE ATT&CK technique matches this behavior, and why does it map?
answer:
- T1195.003.
- T1195.003 corresponds to compromising hardware supply chain, mapping CAPEC-522: replacing legitimate hardware with tampered components to disrupt or enable compromise.
